day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take the Disney Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft) to your boutique stay near Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista. Check in, unpack, and get oriented. Pick up a Disney park map and review your week's game plan. Walk around the hotel area and locate nearby amenities, bus stops, and the Disney Transportation hub.
day_by_day.evening: Take the free Disney bus or monorail to Disney Springs (no park ticket required). Explore the outdoor shopping and entertainment district at no cost. Enjoy live street performers, window shop, and soak in the Disney atmosphere. Great low-cost way to kick off the trip and get into the Disney spirit.

meals.breakfast: Eat before or during the flight to save money
meals.lunch: Grab a quick, affordable bite at the airport or a fast-casual spot near the hotel upon arrival — budget around $10–$12 per person
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: Earl of Sandwich or Blaze Pizza offer filling meals for $10–$14 per person. Split shareable items to save more.

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is intentionally light. Rest is key — the parks are physically demanding. Download the My Disney Experience app to manage park reservations, Genie+ selections, and wait times. Purchase any remaining park tickets in advance online for the best prices. Confirm park reservations for all upcoming days.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom — Arrive at rope drop (park opens around 9:00 AM, arrive by 8:30 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland or Fantasyland first to hit major rides before crowds build. Prioritize: Space Mountain, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Peter Pan's Flight. Use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times in real time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Grab a mid-day lunch and take a break during peak heat hours (12:00–2:00 PM). Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check schedule). Explore Liberty Square and Adventureland — ride Pirates of the Caribbean and Haunted Mansion. Catch the Hall of Presidents for a free air-conditioned rest. Revisit morning favorites with shorter afternoon lines.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the TRON Lightcycle / Run or other evening rides with reduced waits. Watch the Magic Kingdom Fireworks (Enchantment) — typically at 9:00 PM. This is a bucket-list moment and completely included in park admission. Exit after fireworks using Disney bus transportation back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Eat a hearty breakfast at the hotel or bring granola bars and fruit to the park to save money
meals.lunch: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café (Tomorrowland) — counter service, burgers and chicken for $12–$15 per person
meals.dinner: Columbia Harbour House (Liberty Square) — clam chowder, fish & chips, or chicken for $13–$16 per person. One of Magic Kingdom's best budget counter-service spots.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring a refillable water bottle — free ice water is available at any quick-service location. Sunscreen is essential in June. Arrive early to maximize time before afternoon heat and crowds peak. Rope drop strategy saves hours of waiting.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT — Arrive at rope drop. Head immediately to World Discovery: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane — check app at 7:00 AM) and Test Track. Then visit Mission: SPACE for a space simulation experience. These rides have the longest waits and are best tackled first thing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Nature: Journey of Water (Moana-inspired, walk-through, free with admission) and Soarin' Around the World in World Discovery. Then stroll into World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Walk the 11 international pavilions — Canada, UK, France, Morocco, Japan, America, Italy, Germany, China, Norway, and Mexico. Each pavilion has free entertainment, cultural exhibits, and character meet-and-greets.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the World Showcase atmosphere as it comes alive at night. Watch EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over the World Showcase Lagoon — free with park admission and one of the most impressive shows on property. Browse the international pavilion shops before heading back to the hotel via Disney bus.

meals.breakfast: Bring snacks from the hotel or grab a quick pastry at the France Pavilion bakery (~$5–$7)
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — one of EPCOT's best-value counter-service spots with rotating hot dishes, sandwiches, and salads for $12–$15
meals.dinner: World Showcase food stands — graze affordably through international pavilions. Try a School Bread from Norway (~$6), a crepe from France (~$8), and a taco from Mexico (~$9). Mix-and-match for a fun, budget-friendly dinner under $20.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most walkable park — comfortable shoes are a must. The World Showcase is a cultural highlight and entirely free to explore once inside the park. June often features EPCOT's International Food & Wine Festival or Flower & Garden Festival — check the schedule for bonus free entertainment and special food booths.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Arrive at rope drop. This park requires the most strategic planning. Use the virtual queue or Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (book at 7:00 AM via the app). Head to Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land immediately after — these fill up fast. Ride Rock 'n' Roller Coaster and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror before 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — visit the Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run (standby line moves well mid-afternoon). Browse Black Spire Outpost marketplace and the stunning immersive land theming. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check show times). Take in the Beauty and the Beast Live on Stage show for a fun, air-conditioned break.
day_by_day.evening: Watch Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' nighttime spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse, water screens, and fireworks. Check the show schedule and arrive 45–60 minutes early for a good seat. This is included with park admission. Head back to the hotel after the show via Disney transportation.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel before heading out to maximize morning rope-drop time
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box (Toy Story Land) — totchos, grilled cheese sandwiches, and lemonade for $10–$13. Fun theming and good value.
meals.dinner: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge) — roasted chicken, noodle bowls, or Ronto wraps for $13–$16. The Star Wars theming makes it a memorable budget meal.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is the most attraction-dense park and requires the most Lightning Lane or virtual queue strategy. Check the My Disney Experience app the night before to pre-plan. The park can feel crowded mid-day — use that time for shows and slower-paced experiences. Fantasmic! seating fills up quickly, so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Arrive at rope drop. Animals are most active in the cooler morning hours, making this the ideal time to visit. Head straight to Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora — The World of Avatar (the park's most popular ride). Then ride Na'vi River Journey nearby. Next, cross to Africa for Kilimanjaro Safaris — morning is the best time to see active wildlife.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail (free walking trail with gorillas, hippos, and exotic birds). Watch the Festival of the Lion King show (check times) — a high-energy Broadway-style performance included with admission. Visit Asia: ride Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (expect to get wet — great for hot June afternoons). Explore DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride and Primeval Whirl.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Rivers of Light or Tree of Life Awakenings — the Tree of Life comes alive with animal imagery projected onto its surface after dark. A magical, peaceful evening experience. Enjoy the park's unique nighttime atmosphere before heading back to the hotel. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks — plan accordingly.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick snack at the hotel — Harambe Market opens early in the park if needed
meals.lunch: Harambe Market (Africa) — outdoor African-inspired counter service with chicken skewers, ribs, and corn on the cob for $12–$16. Great atmosphere and value.
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora) — one of Disney's best counter-service restaurants. Grain bowls, protein options, and unique drinks for $13–$17. Healthy, filling, and budget-friendly.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning due to animal activity and cooler temperatures. Bring a light rain poncho — Kali River Rapids will soak you, and June afternoon showers are common. The park's natural beauty and theming are stunning — take time to explore the walking trails and details. Check park closing time, as Animal Kingdom often closes earlier than other parks.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and Resort Day — Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed morning. Take advantage of the hotel's amenities. Visit a Disney resort pool (guests can sometimes access other Disney resort pools — check current policy). Alternatively, return to a favorite park for a second visit using your multi-day ticket. Use this morning to revisit any missed attractions or re-ride favorites with potentially shorter mid-week lines.
day_by_day.afternoon: Free Exploration Day — Visit Disney Springs again for free entertainment, browsing, and people-watching. Check out the LEGO Store, World of Disney shop (browsing is free!), and live entertainment stages. Alternatively, take a free Disney bus tour of the resort — ride the monorail loop around the Seven Seas Lagoon for a free scenic experience passing the Grand Floridian, Polynesian, and Magic Kingdom area.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for a second evening visit — evening hours often have shorter wait times. Catch any rides or experiences missed on Day 2. Watch the fireworks one more time from a different vantage point (Main Street USA, or the bridge near the train station for a wider view). Alternatively, enjoy a relaxed dinner at Disney Springs and call it an early night to recharge.

meals.breakfast: Cook a simple breakfast using groceries purchased at a nearby Publix or Walmart — saves significant money. Cereal, fruit, yogurt, and juice are easy hotel-room options.
meals.lunch: Picnic-style lunch using grocery store items near the pool or hotel grounds — sandwiches, chips, and fruit for under $8 per person
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: The BOATHOUSE or STK are splurge options, but for budget dining try Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri — chicken tenders and dipping sauces for $12–$15. Fun, casual, and filling.

day_by_day.notes: Day 6 is intentionally flexible — use it to rest tired feet, revisit favorites, or catch anything missed earlier in the week. Grocery shopping at a nearby store (Publix on Apopka-Vineland Road is close) for snacks, breakfast items, and drinks can save $30–$50 over the course of the trip. Many families find this the most relaxing and enjoyable day of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning Magic — Wake up early for one last Disney experience. If your flight is in the afternoon or evening, use the morning for a final park visit. Magic Kingdom opens early and is best in the morning. Ride any last must-do attractions. Pick up any final souvenirs (Disney Springs has the widest selection at the best prices compared to in-park shops). Check out of the hotel and store luggage with the concierge if needed.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on flight time — wrap up any final activities by noon. Head back to the hotel to collect luggage. Arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport (MCO) — allow 45–60 minutes travel time plus 2 hours for airport security. Rideshare (Uber/Lyft) from Disney area to MCO typically costs $25–$40. Reflect on an amazing week of Disney magic!
day_by_day.evening: Travel home — depart from Orlando International Airport. Bring Disney snacks purchased at the resort or grocery store for the flight to avoid expensive airport food.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast using any remaining grocery store items — use up everything to avoid waste
meals.lunch: Quick counter-service meal in the park if visiting, or grab something affordable near the hotel before heading to the airport. Budget $10–$13.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or pack snacks for the flight home to save money on expensive terminal food

day_by_day.notes: Check flight details carefully and plan airport departure timing conservatively — Orlando airport can be busy, especially in June. Return any rented items, double-check the hotel room for left belongings, and confirm transportation. Take a final photo at the hotel before leaving. Total estimated food budget for the week using counter-service dining and some grocery store supplementing: $400–$550 for a family of 4. Park tickets purchased in advance online offer the best savings — look for multi-day discounts on the official Disney website.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Check-In — Flight LH lands at 13:00, so no morning activities. Use this time to rest on the plane and prepare for the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport transfer to Boutique Stay in Magic Kingdom area. Check in, freshen up, and explore the hotel grounds. Pick up a Disney park map, download the My Disney Experience app, and plan your week. Take a leisurely stroll around the Magic Kingdom resort area to get oriented.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening — Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket needed) for a relaxed first night. Enjoy live street entertainment, browse the shops, and soak in the Disney atmosphere without the pressure of a full park day.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at the airport before landing.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at Orlando International Airport or a convenience stop on the way to the hotel.
meals.dinner: The Polite Pig at Disney Springs — a mid-range BBQ restaurant with craft cocktails and family-friendly options. Budget approx. $20–$35 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Since arrival is at 13:00, allow 60–90 minutes for baggage claim, transport, and check-in. Disney Springs is about 10–15 minutes from the Magic Kingdom resort area and requires no park ticket. Wear comfortable shoes — you'll walk more than expected even on day one.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure (Part 1) — Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM, arrive by 8:30 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Use Lightning Lane for Space Mountain if available. Then hit Big Thunder Mountain Railroad in Frontierland.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure (Part 2) — After lunch, explore Fantasyland: ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (book Lightning Lane in advance), Peter Pan's Flight, and the Haunted Mansion. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check daily schedule, typically ~3:00 PM). Cool off with a Dole Whip at Aloha Isle.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular — EPCOT Forever or Magic Kingdom's fireworks show 'Disney Enchantment' (check current schedule for 2027). Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. about 30 minutes before showtime.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or grab a quick bite at the Main Street Bakery inside Magic Kingdom (try the Starbucks items and Mickey waffles).
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — mid-range counter service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and chicken sandwiches. Budget ~$15–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant or Tony's Town Square Restaurant for a sit-down experience (~$35–$55 per person), OR save money with Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn for hearty Tex-Mex at counter service prices (~$15–$20 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance for this day — Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and TRON Lightcycle Run (if available) are must-book individual Lightning Lanes. Wear sunscreen and bring a refillable water bottle. June weather in Orlando is hot and humid (88–93°F) with afternoon thunderstorms possible — pack a small poncho.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Part 1) — Arrive at EPCOT for rope drop (~9:00 AM). Start in Future World/World Discovery: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines grow. Then make your way to the World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Part 2) — Walk the World Showcase promenade and sample food and drinks from multiple countries. Highlights: Crepes in France, Ramen in Japan, Pasteis de Nata in Portugal, and a refreshing drink in Mexico's La Cava del Tequila. Ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion and Frozen Ever After in Norway.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime show — 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Luminous the Symphony of Us' (verify 2027 schedule). Enjoy the fireworks over World Showcase Lagoon from the International Gateway bridge for a stunning view.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or quick service at EPCOT's Connections Café near the park entrance.
meals.lunch: Graze through the World Showcase food kiosks — budget $25–$35 per person on small plates and drinks from 3–4 different countries for an authentic food tour experience.
meals.dinner: Via Napoli Ristorante e Pizzeria in the Italy Pavilion — wood-fired Neapolitan pizzas in a beautiful setting. Mid-range at ~$30–$45 per person. Reservations strongly recommended.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the best park for foodies and culture lovers. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World rides. Book dining reservations 60 days in advance. If traveling with young children, the Norway and France pavilions have the most kid-friendly rides.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience (Part 1) — Arrive early (8:30 AM for rope drop). Head directly to Galaxy's Edge. Book a Savi's Workshop Lightsaber Building experience in advance ($249.99 per lightsaber, 1 per person, but a memorable splurge). Alternatively, visit the Droid Depot to build a custom droid (~$119.99). Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first thing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios (Part 2) — After Galaxy's Edge, ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of the best theme park attractions in the world — book Lightning Lane Individual). Then explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Tower of Terror, Rock 'n' Roller Coaster, and Toy Story Land. Catch a live show like Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular.
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios Nighttime — Stay for 'Fantasmic!' the nighttime spectacular at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check 2027 schedule for show times). This water, fire, and projection show is a Hollywood Studios highlight. Grab a Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed seating.

meals.breakfast: Quick service at Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — great toasted cheese sandwiches and 'Lunch Box Tarts.' Budget ~$12–$15 per person.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — themed Star Wars food in an immersive setting. Try the Smoked Kaadu Ribs or Fried Endorian Tip-Yip. Budget ~$18–$25 per person.
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café — a fun, themed diner experience with comfort food like pot roast and fried chicken. Mid-range at ~$30–$45 per person. Great for families. Make reservations.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop and Droid Depot require advance reservations and sell out quickly — book as soon as your 60-day booking window opens. Rise of the Resistance is the most in-demand attraction; purchase Lightning Lane Individual early in the morning. June is peak season so Hollywood Studios will be very busy.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar (Part 1) — Arrive at rope drop (typically 8:00 AM, one of the earliest opening parks). Head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the most immersive ride at Walt Disney World). The line builds extremely fast — arrive before park opening. Also ride Na'vi River Journey in Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Animal Kingdom (Part 2) — Join the Kilimanjaro Safaris in Africa for a 20-minute open-air safari to see lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and more. Best wildlife activity in early afternoon. Explore Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail afterward. Then head to Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (bring a change of clothes or a poncho).
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 7:00–8:00 PM). Head back to the hotel to freshen up, then enjoy a relaxed evening at your boutique stay or return to Disney Springs for dessert and entertainment.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel before heading out early — Animal Kingdom rewards early arrivals.
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue — one of the best counter service options at Disney World, with smoked ribs, pulled pork, and waterfront seating. Budget ~$15–$22 per person.
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom (if still open in evening) for upscale dining at ~$55–$75 per person, OR head to Disney Springs for dinner at Raglan Road Irish Pub — great atmosphere, live music, and hearty Irish-American food at ~$25–$40 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Flight of Passage is the #1 most sought-after Lightning Lane at Disney World — purchase it the moment you enter the park or book it via the app at 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Animal Kingdom is beautiful in the morning light. Bring insect repellent for the outdoor trails. The park often closes earlier than others, so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Flex / Revisit Favorite Park Day — Use this morning as a buffer day. Sleep in a bit and enjoy a leisurely hotel breakfast. Then choose to revisit your favorite park from earlier in the week, focusing on any rides or experiences you missed. Alternatively, visit Disney's Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach water park (separate ticket required, ~$89–$109/person) for a refreshing break from theme parks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Pool & Relaxation — Spend the hottest part of the afternoon (2:00–5:00 PM) at your boutique hotel's pool or the nearest Disney resort pool. This is a smart strategy in June heat and lets the family recharge before the final full day tomorrow.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Return for Nighttime Magic — Head back to Magic Kingdom for a shorter evening visit focused on experiencing the park at night. Rides like the Haunted Mansion, Pirates of the Caribbean, and It's a Small World are magical after dark. Stay for the fireworks if you didn't catch them on Day 2.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — take your time and enjoy a full sit-down meal at the boutique stay.
meals.lunch: If at a water park, grab food from the park's counter service. If at the resort pool, order from the pool bar/grill (~$15–$25 per person).
meals.dinner: Chef Mickey's at Disney's Contemporary Resort — a beloved character dining experience with Mickey, Minnie, and friends. Great for families with kids. Mid-range buffet at ~$55–$65 per adult, ~$35–$40 per child. Reservations essential.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically the busiest day at Disney World as local and weekend visitors arrive. If revisiting a park, use Lightning Lane strategically and visit in the evening when some crowds thin out. The water parks are a fantastic mid-trip refresher and often less crowded than the main theme parks.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning — Magic Kingdom Farewell or EPCOT Brunch — Depending on your flight time, spend a final morning at your favorite park. If leaving in the afternoon, get to Magic Kingdom for a 2–3 hour morning visit. Ride your top two favorites one last time and grab a Mickey-shaped treat as a farewell. Check out of the hotel (most checkout is 11:00 AM — request late checkout if needed).
day_by_day.afternoon: Hotel Checkout & Departure Prep — Return to the hotel, collect luggage, and arrange airport transport. Allow 2 hours before your flight for transport and airport procedures from the Disney area. Browse hotel gift shop for any last-minute souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — Head to Orlando International Airport. Reflect on an incredible week at Walt Disney World!

meals.breakfast: Crystal Palace at Magic Kingdom — a character breakfast buffet with Winnie the Pooh and friends in a beautiful Victorian greenhouse setting. Budget ~$45–$55 per adult. Book in advance. Alternatively, grab pastries and coffee from Main Street Bakery for a lighter, quicker option (~$10–$15 per person).
meals.lunch: Quick lunch near the park exit or back at the hotel — keep it simple as you prepare for departure. Grab a sandwich or snack from a Disney resort quick service location.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport, or pack Disney-themed snacks purchased earlier in the week for the flight home.

day_by_day.notes: On departure day, store your luggage with the hotel bell services so you can enjoy a few final hours without hauling bags. Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare (Uber/Lyft) typically takes 30–45 minutes to the airport — plan accordingly. Don't forget to check for any park merchandise or souvenirs you want before leaving the resort area. Take lots of photos on your last morning!

experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes roaming freely. Then soar over Pandora on the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage ride in Pandora – The World of Avatar. End the day with the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular.
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Bay Lake, Orlando

experiences.name: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening
experiences.description: Spend a free-admission evening at Disney Springs exploring world-class dining, live entertainment, and unique shopping. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe, catch a live street performance, and let the kids explore the LEGO Store and World of Disney. A perfect budget-friendly family night out.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Hotel Check-In — Flight LH lands at 13:00, so no morning activities scheduled. Upon landing, a pre-arranged private luxury transfer (e.g., Mears Connect First Class or private car service) whisks you from Orlando International Airport to your boutique stay at Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista. Settle in, freshen up, and explore the resort amenities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Orientation & Disney Springs Stroll — After settling in, take a leisurely private shuttle to Disney Springs for a low-key first afternoon. Browse upscale boutiques like Curl by Sam Edelman and the Disney flagship store, enjoy live entertainment, and decompress from travel in a relaxed, no-ticket-required setting.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening — Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of Disney Springs at night with live music, waterfront views, and world-class dining. Explore the entertainment district and end the night with a cocktail at a rooftop bar before a restful return to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on the plane or grab a light snack at Orlando International Airport's The Club MCO lounge upon arrival.
meals.lunch: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — A stylish modern steakhouse offering premium cuts, craft cocktails, and a lively ambiance perfect for kicking off a luxury Disney trip.
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Celebrity chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant offering exquisite dim sum, Peking duck, and a stunning two-story interior with theatrical flair.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book a private luxury airport transfer in advance. Disney Springs requires no park ticket. Consider purchasing the Disney Genie+ and Individual Lightning Lane selections for the days ahead via the My Disney Experience app tonight. Confirm all park reservations are in order.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure (Morning) — Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) via the iconic monorail or ferry from your resort. Start with Tomorrowland's Space Mountain and then move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Individual Lightning Lane. Explore Cinderella Castle and enjoy character meet-and-greets in a relatively uncrowded early morning window.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Park Continued — After lunch, tackle Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Use Disney Genie+ Lightning Lane passes strategically to minimize wait times. Enjoy the afternoon parade (Festival of Fantasy) from a premium reserved viewing area if available through your concierge.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Fireworks Spectacular — Stay for the legendary 'Disney Enchantment' or 'Happily Ever After' nighttime spectacular over Cinderella Castle. Secure a premium fireworks dessert party package through Disney for reserved viewing with exclusive treats and beverages, then enjoy a relaxed monorail ride back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: The Grand Floridian Café (at the nearby Grand Floridian Resort) — Elegant Florida-inspired breakfast with fresh pastries, eggs Benedict, and fresh-squeezed juices before heading to the park.
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom — Dine in the enchanted Beast's Castle with French-inspired cuisine including prime rib and croque monsieur in a breathtaking fairy-tale setting. Reservations essential.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table — A once-in-a-lifetime fine dining experience inside Cinderella Castle with princess character dining, prix-fixe American cuisine, and stunning views of the Magic Kingdom. Book 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Rope drop strategy is critical at Magic Kingdom — arrive 30 minutes before official park opening. The Cinderella's Royal Table dinner and Be Our Guest lunch require advance dining reservations (ADRs) made 60 days prior. The fireworks dessert party is an upcharge experience bookable through Disney's website. Wear comfortable shoes — expect 15,000+ steps.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Morning) — Head to EPCOT at opening and begin with Future World / World Discovery. Ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane) and Test Track. Then transition into the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM, beginning your cultural journey through the 11 country pavilions.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Deep Dive — Explore France, Japan, Morocco, Italy, and Canada pavilions. Participate in interactive cultural experiences, browse artisan shops, and enjoy curated food and beverage tastings at each pavilion. Consider booking the 'EPCOT Food & Wine' premium tasting experience or a private sommelier-led wine tour through the World Showcase if available.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious Nighttime Spectacular — Stay for EPCOT's stunning nighttime show 'Harmonious' (or its current equivalent), one of the largest nighttime spectaculars ever created. Book the EPCOT IllumiNations or Harmonious Dessert Party for reserved lakeside seating with premium desserts and sparkling wine.

meals.breakfast: Kona Café at Disney's Polynesian Village Resort — Celebrated for its Tonga Toast (a must-try signature dish), Kona blend coffee, and relaxed tropical ambiance before heading to EPCOT.
meals.lunch: Chefs de France in EPCOT's France Pavilion — Authentic French brasserie cuisine featuring crêpes, French onion soup, and classic entrées in an elegant Parisian-style setting.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in EPCOT's Japan Pavilion — Premium teppanyaki-style dining with theatrical tableside cooking, premium wagyu beef, and sake pairings in a beautifully designed Japanese setting.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase officially opens at 11:00 AM, so plan Future World rides in the early morning. The Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind uses a virtual queue — join at 7:00 AM via My Disney Experience app. The EPCOT Dessert Party for the nighttime show is a premium upcharge and books out fast — reserve well in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience — Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Galaxy's Edge. Begin with Rise of the Resistance (one of the most immersive theme park attractions ever built) using Individual Lightning Lane. Then experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore the Black Spire Outpost marketplace and engage with interactive droids and stormtroopers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Savi's Workshop Lightsaber Building & Hollywood Studios Highlights — Book the premium Savi's Workshop experience to hand-build a custom lightsaber (approximately $300 per saber, reservations required). Afterward, explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash), Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith, and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror.
day_by_day.evening: Fantasmic! Premium Dining Package & Nighttime Show — Experience the spectacular Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater. Book the Fantasmic! Dining Package at Hollywood Brown Derby or Mama Melrose's for guaranteed reserved seating at the show, included with a premium dining experience.

meals.breakfast: Hollywood Brown Derby Lounge — Enjoy a sophisticated pre-park breakfast inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood restaurant, featuring the iconic Cobb salad and grapefruit cake.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — Thematic quick-service dining inside Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge with creative dishes like Ronto Wraps and Felucian Garden Spread, fully immersed in the Star Wars universe.
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby — The crown jewel of Hollywood Studios dining, offering classic American cuisine with a glamorous Old Hollywood atmosphere, signature cocktails, and exceptional service. The Fantasmic! Dining Package here ensures reserved show seating.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop requires advance reservations and costs approximately $299.99 per lightsaber — absolutely worth it for Star Wars fans. Rise of the Resistance is the most sought-after attraction at Disney World; secure an Individual Lightning Lane as early as possible at 7:00 AM. Droid Depot (build-your-own droid, ~$119.99) is another premium Galaxy's Edge experience worth considering if time allows.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience (Morning) — Arrive at Animal Kingdom at rope drop for the Kilimanjaro Safaris, which offers the best wildlife activity in the early morning when animals are most active. See lions, elephants, giraffes, and rhinos in an expansive, authentic African savanna setting. Follow with Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pandora — The World of Avatar — Head to Pandora for the crown jewel of Animal Kingdom: Avatar Flight of Passage. This breathtaking, immersive ride simulates flying on a banshee over the bioluminescent world of Pandora and is widely regarded as the best theme park attraction in the world. Use Individual Lightning Lane for guaranteed access. Also experience Na'vi River Journey for a serene, visually stunning boat ride.
day_by_day.evening: Tree of Life Awakening & Rivers of Light — As dusk falls, gather near the iconic Tree of Life to witness the magical 'Tree of Life Awakening' projection show where the carved animals come to life with light and sound. If available, experience Rivers of Light or the current nighttime spectacular at Animal Kingdom before departing.

meals.breakfast: Boma — Flavors of Africa at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge — An extraordinary African-inspired buffet breakfast featuring bobotie, pap, jungle juice, and 65+ unique dishes in a stunning lodge setting, even if staying elsewhere. Worth the short trip.
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney's most acclaimed fine dining restaurant inside a park, offering globally inspired cuisine with dishes like whole-roasted cauliflower, sustainable fish, and artisanal cocktails in a stunning gallery-like space.
meals.dinner: Jiko — The Cooking Place at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge — One of the most celebrated restaurants at Walt Disney World, featuring African and South African wine-paired cuisine including oak-grilled filet, maize-crusted fish, and an award-winning wine list with over 70 South African labels.

day_by_day.notes: Kilimanjaro Safaris is best experienced at rope drop (early morning) when animals are most active and temperatures are cooler. Avatar Flight of Passage is the most popular attraction at Animal Kingdom — secure Individual Lightning Lane at 7:00 AM sharp. Tiffins requires an advance dining reservation. Jiko is one of the hardest reservations to get at Disney World — book exactly 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: VIP Tour Experience — Book a Private VIP Tour Guide through Walt Disney World (starting at approximately $450–$900+ per hour, 7-hour minimum). Your dedicated VIP guide provides front-of-line access to attractions across multiple parks, personalized itinerary planning, and exclusive behind-the-scenes insights. Use this morning to revisit favorite attractions from the week or tackle anything missed, with zero waiting.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT Revisit or Resort Relaxation — Use the afternoon of your VIP tour day to either revisit EPCOT for any missed pavilions and attractions (Frozen Ever After, Remy's Ratatouille Adventure) or spend a luxurious afternoon at your resort's pool, spa, or enjoying a private cabana if available. This is a perfect recovery afternoon before the final evening celebration.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell Celebration Dinner & Magic Kingdom Evening — Return to Magic Kingdom for a final magical evening. Ride any remaining must-do attractions and enjoy the park's beautiful Main Street USA at night. End the Disney World experience with a premium farewell dinner at one of Disney's most iconic restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Victoria & Albert's Chef's Table — The most prestigious dining experience in all of Walt Disney World (and one of the finest in Florida), offering an intimate, multi-course prix-fixe tasting menu with wine pairings prepared by a world-class culinary team. Located at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort. Reservations open 60 days in advance and sell out immediately — this is the pinnacle of Disney fine dining.
meals.lunch: Skipper Canteen at Magic Kingdom — A charming, story-rich quick-service lunch option themed around the Jungle Cruise, offering globally inspired cuisine in a unique, character-filled environment perfect for a lighter midday meal.
meals.dinner: Narcoossee's at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort — An upscale waterfront restaurant offering premium seafood, prime steaks, and stunning views of the Seven Seas Lagoon and Magic Kingdom fireworks. The perfect farewell dinner with a front-row view of the nightly fireworks spectacular from the restaurant's terrace.

day_by_day.notes: The Private VIP Tour must be booked well in advance by calling (407) 560-4033. It is the single most effective way to experience Disney World without waiting in lines and is highly recommended for luxury travelers. Victoria & Albert's Chef's Table is the hardest reservation at all of Disney World — book at exactly 60 days out at 6:00 AM EST. Narcoossee's fireworks view is spectacular — request a window table when booking.

day_by_day.morning: Leisure Morning & Resort Farewell — Enjoy a final relaxed morning at your boutique resort. Take a leisurely stroll around the resort grounds, enjoy a spa treatment if available, or simply savor a final Disney breakfast without rushing. Pack and prepare for checkout, arranging luggage storage with the concierge if your flight departs later in the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Disney Springs Shopping & Departure — Head to Disney Springs one last time for any last-minute souvenir shopping at upscale boutiques (Anthropologie, Alex and Ani, The Art of Disney). Pick up premium gifts from Goofy's Candy Co. or the Marketplace Co-Op. Arrange your private luxury transfer back to Orlando International Airport with plenty of time before your departure flight.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — Board your return flight with magical memories, a collection of premium Disney souvenirs, and the satisfaction of having experienced Walt Disney World at the absolute highest level. Consider enrolling in Disney's Magical Express or a private car service for a seamless, stress-free airport transfer.

meals.breakfast: 1900 Park Fare at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort — A beloved character breakfast buffet featuring Cinderella, Prince Charming, and the stepsisters, with a lavish spread of fresh pastries, eggs, carved meats, and Florida specialties in a stunning Victorian-era carousel dining room.
meals.lunch: The Boathouse at Disney Springs — A nautical-themed upscale restaurant offering fresh seafood towers, lobster, prime steaks, and craft cocktails with stunning waterfront views. Perfect for a celebratory farewell lunch.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight — Depending on departure time, enjoy a final meal at The Club MCO lounge at Orlando International Airport or savor a premium in-flight dining experience on your return journey.

day_by_day.notes: Check-out time is typically 11:00 AM — arrange late checkout with the concierge if needed (often available at luxury properties for a fee). Disney Springs opens at 10:00 AM. Allow at least 2–2.5 hours before your flight for the drive to the airport, security, and boarding. Consider shipping larger souvenir purchases directly home via Disney's package shipping service to avoid luggage complications. The My Disney Experience app allows you to manage all reservations, Lightning Lane purchases, and park passes throughout the trip.
